svg.title: Kartik Khurana
svg.desc: Illustrated 3D-style portrait of Kartik: thick tousled dark hair, very thick brows, big squarish grey-green glasses, a full dark beard with a few grey flecks, a gentle smile, and a bottle-green knit polo with orange-and-white tipped collar, in a deep-space nebula with a neural-network constellation, a ringed planet, a galaxy, floating equations and a glowing Gaussian-process plot.
